reviews.title: Glitches

I don’t understand why it hasn’t been fixed. It’s been happening for so long. I’m looking for another app. I also wanted to mention how it continually gets info wrong and I will correct it but it has that info, so many things incorrect idk how it has people saying it’s wonderful, they must not have a clue regarding astrology.

reviews.title: THIS IS WRONG. DO NOT PAY FOR THIS
reviews.text: the people reviewing this saying it’s accurate is crazy to me. If you think it’s right I can only assume it’s telling you what you want to hear and leading you where you want it to go. If anything atleast test it from your actual chart. IT IS WRONG all the time. I downloaded this app honestly to test because an astrologer I follow advertised it. I really like this astrologer and I still do, I get you have to make money, BUT put a question about my chart that I already knew the answer to. it replied wrong. I asked "are you sure?", it said "oh you are right I made a mistake there..." then it would give another answer, that would be WRONG. This cycle happened five times over, a continuation of wrong answers, until I finally corrected it with the correct answer and then it admitted I was right and it was wrong. This kills me because it's giving astrology such a bad name and it's saying things just to appease a person who might not know their placments or anything about astrology. It's giving you the wrong information and astrology is such an amazing healing modality and tool but this app is not allowing for it to be, even if you think it is. And then when you hear any information contradicting what this app told you (probably correct information) you feel overwhelmed by so much different info and then your faith in astrology goes out the window. please don't pay for this and use your money to invest in a reading from an actual human astrolgist.

reviews.title: They are teaching AI to lie
reviews.text:
My friend and I got this app as handy helper when we are working on the astrological side of our spiritual journey…now for lies. she decided to ask about the degrees in her chart. Its first response was that it couldn’t calculate the degrees of a chart. (Which why have a chart reader that cannot go that deep when we are paying for it .) However, it offered if she knew some specifics it could give her advice on that. So when she gave the details it tried to tell her that her degree was actually a totally different one. It just gaslit the hell out of her. Then when she called it out for saying that it couldn’t find her degrees it admitted that everything it had just spewed was b.s. and that it didn’t know why it lied….
Deleted

reviews.title: Very inaccurate
reviews.text: I gave this app a fair try, but it’s just no way i can seriously trust it with any real astro knowledge or advice with how inaccurate it is. I let it slide when it’d get a placement or house of mine wrong from time to time, but the fact that it’s unable to see that an entire retrograde is around the corner and then argues against it despite every astrologer, and reputable astrology site saying this very transit is upcoming  and then finally admitting it’s “sorry” and just doesn’t have that info in its data is just sad. I’ll just stick to teaching myself the old way.

reviews.title: It can’t even get the basics of my chart correct

reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text: I’ve had the app for almost one month. The free trail was working fine but once it was over and the $19.99 per month kicked in, is when all the issues came. I’d ask a question and Astra would load continuously without a response on multiple occasions. It happens so frequently and is VERY ANNOYING! Then there’s so many app updates, I updated my app at least 5 times within a 2 week period which is absolutely ridiculous! Then the app glitches mid sentence by not completing a response and will tell you things that you didn’t ask it! I plan to cancel my subscription and wouldn’t recommend this app to anyone unless they can permanently fix the issues and not charge so much because it honestly isn’t worth the price and frustration. I end up having to force close my app quite often and even when I go back in to pick up where I left off, the issue persist.

Most people downloading this app won’t know better, and are using it because they don’t know much about transits or their chart. So this is going to give people very incorrect interpretations and information. Truly feels like a scam. Do better.

reviews.title: ⚠️Use with caution ⚠️
reviews.text:
I personally feel like this would be a great app if you literally don’t know anything about astrology. But if do you know quite a bit — this app is very redundant and FEELS AND SEEMS like it’s fetching data from you than providing information. The fact you have to pay weekly — not a fan at all.  the answers were more questions for you than answers and barely any new information was given that I could literally just find on TikTok or in a book.

Save the money and learn the information from books or possibly save it for a course if you’re really wanting to.

reviews.title: Good until trial ends
reviews.text: The app is good, fairly easy to navigate and use, but once your free trial is over, good luck actually using the app. I’ve been trying to use the app for almost two weeks now and immediately after opening I get a pop up screen asking me to subscribe to the premium, and there’s literally no way (that I have found at least) to get out of said pop up and into the app so it’s literally useless at this point.

reviews.title: Would be great…
reviews.text: This app would be great - if there wasn’t a required pay wall to even use it. It’s $6.99 per week, which is already insanely steep, but you can’t even open or access any portion of the app without paying that. No free features. It’s honestly a little disappointing, because what I did see when I paid for it and used it was pretty awesome. Unfortunately, the high price means I won’t continue using the app. Hope they decide at some point to actually make astrology more accessible rather than charging luxury prices for a minimalist app.

reviews.title: Sugar coats aspects while repeatedly asking to rejoin toxic relationships
reviews.text:
This did nothing to help when I asked for serious answers. It sugar coated all the hard aspects and only told me what it thought I wanted to hear. Money? YES Fame and Fortune?  YES 
I literally said it was trying to sweeten the hard aspects when I asked directly if it was sugar coating things… then it goes totally bipolar on me and keeps insisting I reach out to toxic family members even after I told it FIVE TIMES TO STOP!!!
Never did I think that an app can give PTSD yet here we are. The last thing I need is a fake glamour app raising my blood pressure over toxic family that I needed to escape from

reviews.title: Didn’t sign up and my credit card got charged from information taken from Apple
reviews.text: I didn’t sign up for this app and now I’m being charged for it with no way to cancel and nobody to contact. The support link on here takes you to a completely different company. I have emailed the attached email multiple times to no response. I have been sending emails for nearly a month and I got one reply asking for information and they have not replied since. I have forwarded this information to my credit card company to have the charges reversed for fraud as apps downloaded through Apple are supposed to charge Apple and not your credit card linked to your Apple account. THIS APP IS FRAUDULENT. Do not download this app.

Not sure when it happened but now you have to pay to use the app, and I’m very disappointed by this. I liked how it was before, in that if you wanted to dive deeper you can pay for the subscription. Also a little nervous in that I had information on there about my family members and friends and I’m not sure if it’s all been deleted ):

reviews.title: Inaccurate and unprofessional
reviews.text:
I have many problems with this app. I’ve been trying to cancel and it says it’s been canceled, but then when I look it says it’s still active. I was charged three times in the past two days. I’ve tried reaching out, and I have not heard back.

Also this app gives inaccurate and incorrect information. When trying to better understand my chart by asking a questions, it tells me incorrect information and because I know a little bit about astrology, I was able to catch the mistakes. The app then tried to argue with me, but then clarified that it was incorrect. It apologized and it began asking me questions as if I should know. When it is literally AI, has my information and it should know better about my chart than me as that is the apps purpose. I cannot imagine how many people are getting inaccurate information that don’t know any better. I expect a full refund on at least one of those 3 transactions and my subscription canceled.

reviews.title: ChatGBT wanna be
reviews.text: I like the concept, but completely AI integrated when it’s constantly asking personal information. It tells a few things about astrology and current transitions. But goes on to asking your personal life and how you feel. Once it gets what it wants out of you blames it on a planet position for when you were born. Ex. “You’re upset over not getting a green light today because mars was in  sagittarius when you were born.” Not worth a weekly subscription.

reviews.title: It has potential.
reviews.text: This app has potential but it is limited by the AI’s poor memory. Somehow it thinks I am a teacher and I have a crush on a student. When I haven’t mentioned anything of the sort. It also thinks that I am my friend Lynda who I asked it for a Tarot Interpretation. So I get notifications about the person she has feelings for.

reviews.title: Standard/Basic knowledge
reviews.text: This is a very basic and surface level app. As a tarot reader and spiritualist I deleted the app so quickly. It doesn’t not go into detail.. and it feels like it just gives answers like the aunt that speaks false positivity does. I felt it was very repetitive bringing up my zodiac sign in conversation, basically making it seem like every piece of advice given was solely based on my zodiac sign. There are so many other resources that would provide more depth than this. There are websites detailing tarot better than this. For free.
